fusions.name: Last Hop
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Hurls a spore that deals 20 damage, then hops to 2 more enemies within 5 tiles for 70% of that damage each.

fusions.name: Vaulting Smother
fusions.desc: Leaps up to 7 tiles to the target and deals 12 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Each hit has a 60% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bounce Back
fusions.desc: Springs 2 tiles forward, restoring 15 stamina and 12 health.

fusions.name: Host Mite
fusions.desc: A bonded mite rides with you, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.
